# Project config: where seeds, models, and macros live.
name: scenario
version: "1.0.0"
profile: scenario

model-paths: ["models"]
seed-paths: ["seeds"]
macro-paths: ["macros"]

# One connection target: a local DuckDB file, zero cost, no credentials.
# CI and the pipeline workflow both use it; a Snowflake target would be a
# second output here and nothing else changes.
scenario:
  target: duckdb
  outputs:
    duckdb:
      type: duckdb
      path: scenario.duckdb
      threads: 4

# Seed properties.
version: 2

seeds:
  - name: crm_company
    description: Master company data, the system of record.
    config:
      tags: ['scenario']
      column_types:
        zip: varchar(10)
        phone_number: varchar(20)

company_id,company_name,address,city,state,zip,phone_number,website,primary_contact
1,7-Eleven,218 Peachtree Street NW,Atlanta,GA,30303,(404) 555-0100,www.7-eleven.com,Jane Smith
2,Home Depot,2455 Paces Ferry Road SE,Atlanta,GA,30339,770-433-8211,www.homedepot.com,Mike Jones
3,Delta Air Lines,1030 Delta Boulevard,Atlanta,GA,30354,(404) 715-2600,www.delta.com,Ana Ruiz
4,Chick-fil-A,5200 Buffington Road,Atlanta,GA,30349,(404) 765-8000,www.chick-fil-a.com,Sam Carter
5,Coca-Cola,1 Coca-Cola Plaza NW,Atlanta,GA,30313,(404) 676-2121,www.coca-cola.com,Priya Patel

# Staging contracts.
version: 2

models:
  - name: stg_company
    description: Master company data from the CRM.
    columns:
      - name: company_id
        tests: [unique, not_null]

-- Staging view over the CRM company table.
-- Collapses stray whitespace so the dimension reads clean values.
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    company_id,
    trim({{ replace_all("coalesce(company_name, '')", ' +', ' ') }}) as company_name,
    trim({{ replace_all("coalesce(address, '')", ' +', ' ') }})      as address,
    trim(city)          as city,
    upper(trim(state))  as state,
    trim(zip)           as zip,
    phone_number,
    website,
    primary_contact
from {{ ref('crm_company') }}

# Conformed contracts.
version: 2

models:
  - name: dim_company
    description: The company dimension, one row per CRM company.
    columns:
      - name: company_id
        tests: [unique, not_null]

-- The company dimension. One row per company in the CRM.
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select
    company_id,
    company_name,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zip,
    phone_number,
    website,
    primary_contact
from {{ ref('stg_company') }}
